#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiplyPolynomials(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b, int mod) {
    int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
    int n = 1;
    while (n < need) n <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> aImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        aReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        aImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    
    // FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        while ((j & bit) != 0) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(aReal[i], aReal[j]);
            swap(aImag[i], aImag[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTable(half);
        vector<double> sinTable(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double uR = aReal[i + j];
                double uI = aImag[i + j];
                double vR = aReal[i + j + half] * cosTable[j] - aImag[i + j + half] * sinTable[j];
                double vI = aReal[i + j + half] * sinTable[j] + aImag[i + j + half] * cosTable[j];
                
                aReal[i + j] = uR + vR;
                aImag[i + j] = uI + vI;
                aReal[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                aImag[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> bImag(n, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
        long long x = ((long long)b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        bReal[i] = x & 0x7FFF;
        bImag[i] = x >> 15;
    }
    
    if (a != b) {
        // FFT for b
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while ((j & bit) != 0) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(bReal[i], bReal[j]);
                swap(bImag[i], bImag[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len >> 1;
            vector<double> cosTable(half);
            vector<double> sinTable(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
                sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                    double uR = bReal[i + j];
                    double uI = bImag[i + j];
                    double vR = bReal[i + j + half] * cosTable[j] - bImag[i + j + half] * sinTable[j];
                    double vI = bReal[i + j + half] * sinTable[j] + bImag[i + j + half] * cosTable[j];
                    
                    bReal[i + j] = uR + vR;
                    bImag[i + j] = uI + vI;
                    bReal[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                    bImag[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
                }
            }
        }
    } else {
        bReal = aReal;
        bImag = aImag;
    }
    
    vector<double> resReal(n, 0.0);
    vector<double> resImag(n, 0.0);
    double cf = 0.25 / n;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);
        
        double a1r = aReal[i] + aReal[j];
        double a1i = aImag[i] - aImag[j];
        double a2r = aImag[i] + aImag[j];
        double a2i = aReal[j] - aReal[i];
        
        double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) * cf;
        double b1i = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) * cf;
        double b2r = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) * cf;
        double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) * cf;
        
        resReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resImag[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        while ((j & bit) != 0) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(resReal[i], resReal[j]);
            swap(resImag[i], resImag[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        vector<double> cosTable(half);
        vector<double> sinTable(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosTable[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sinTable[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double uR = resReal[i + j];
                double uI = resImag[i + j];
                double vR = resReal[i + j + half] * cosTable[j] - resImag[i + j + half] * sinTable[j];
                double vI = resReal[i + j + half] * sinTable[j] + resImag[i + j + half] * cosTable[j];
                
                resReal[i + j] = uR + vR;
                resImag[i + j] = uI + vI;
                resReal[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                resImag[i + j + half] = uI - vI;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        resReal[i] /= n;
        resImag[i] /= n;
    }
    
    vector<int> result(need);
    for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
        long long aa = llround(resReal[i]);
        long long bb = llround(resImag[i]);
        result[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int mod = 998244353;
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> v(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        v[x] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> ans = {1};
    int p = n / 2;
    while (true) {
        if (p & 1) {
            ans = multiplyPolynomials(ans, v, mod);
        }
        p >>= 1;
        if (p == 0) break;
        v = multiplyPolynomials(v, v, mod);
    }
    
    long long res = 0;
    for (int x : ans) {
        res = (res + (long long)x * x) % mod;
    }
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
